title: 4-Day Alleppey Backwaters & Munnar Tea Plantation Trail
summary: Authentic private houseboat cruise through Vembanad Lake paired with a high-altitude tea estate trail in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi & Transfer to Alleppey Houseboat
itinerary.description: Private transfer from Cochin International Airport to Alleppey. Board traditional luxury houseboat for an overnight cruise through narrow canals.

itinerary.title: Vembanad Lake Sunrise & Drive to Munnar
itinerary.description: Morning cruise along paddy fields. Disembark at 10 AM and drive through scenic Cheeyappara Waterfalls to Munnar hill station.

itinerary.title: Eravikulam National Park & Tea Plantation Trek
itinerary.description: Guided morning trek through Nilgiri Tahr sanctuary followed by a private tea tasting session at an organic estate.

itinerary.title: Scenic Viewpoints & Departure
itinerary.description: Visit Mattupetty Dam and Top Station viewpoint before private airport transfer back to Kochi.
